title: Peak guard projects the window from current x elapsed, so it acts late on real peaks and holds back on non-peaks
claim: With the peak guard saved on (threshold 2.0 kW from three recorded peaks, margin 0.5 kW) and a steady meter draw read once a minute through a 60-minute window, the guard's suppressing state disagrees with its description in 69 of 300 minute-samples over 5 draws: 0.8 and 1.2 kW (windows that cannot set a peak) are held back for 3 and 21 minutes, and 1.8, 3.0 and 9.0 kW (windows that will) are first held back at minutes 26, 16 and 6 instead of minute 1.
mechanism: power_guard.project_window_mean returns (mean*elapsed + current_kw*elapsed)/window; its docstring (and the computed but unused `remaining`) says the remainder of the window continues at current_kw, i.e. (mean*elapsed + current_kw*remaining)/window. The projection is 0 at the window start, about half the draw early and about twice it near the end, so GuardState.update crosses threshold - margin at the wrong times.

evidence.unit: minute-samples whose suppressing state contradicts the documented rule, over 5 steady draws x 60 min

metric_definition: sum over draws P in {0.8,1.2,1.8,3.0,9.0} kW of minutes m in 0..59 where suppressing != (P > 1.5 and m >= 1)
phenomenon_property: The guard's projection of the open window's billed mean equals what the window averages if the current draw continues for the rest of it; with a steady draw it equals that draw from the first reading.
seam_rule: grep -n 'project_window_mean' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py (its definition and its one caller, coordinator._on_power_event)
reproduction_steps: Options: Grid peak tariff on; Advanced > Fuse and peak guards: Peak guard on; a house power meter
month with three 2.0 kW peaks; meter steady at 1.2 kW
from minute ~39 of every hour the guard holds back hot water and nudges the curve down though the hour averages 1.2 kW
proposed_fix_scope: power_guard.project_window_mean: weight current_kw by the remaining minutes; failing test on a steady draw below and above the line, null control guard off.
